description: This file defines a JSONStorage class that manages thread-safe JSON file operations including load, save, append, update, get by id, and filter functionalities, with logging support.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: Thread-safe JSON storage manager that handles reading, writing, appending, updating, and filtering JSON data files.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a cache path and creates directories if needed.

methods.name: _get_file_path
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for a given filename, appending .json if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads data from a JSON file, returning an empty list if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a list of dictionaries to a JSON file, returning True if successful.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends an item to the JSON file, adding metadata such as id and creation timestamp.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item in the JSON file by id, adding an update timestamp.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the JSON file by its id.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters items in the JSON file based on provided key-value criteria.

search-terms: file load save append update filter
